scope: Same-tick Markdown requested intent and copied presented context
dataPath: Markdown publisher -> immutable content frame -> ScenePresentation layer.contentAnchor -> capture.scene.objects.contentAnchor
requestedIntent: AnnotationTarget.contentAnchor retains the complete native requested quote and scroll.
actualContext: Scene layer/object contentAnchor records the content selection belonging to the displayed frame. Existing source scroll and text runs stay paired.
sourceValidation: Ordinary anchor limits reused; prepared capture actual anchor and scroll must equal the held presentation layer.
oldRecords: Missing actual anchor fields stay absent; no snapshot is synthesized.
